AUTHOR: Pedersen
TITLE: Detection of Marine Animals in a New Underwater Dataset with Varying Visibility
SPECIES: Big fish (mostly Cyclopterus lumpus, Myoxocephalus scorpius), small fish (mostly Gasterosteus aculeatus, gobies, sprat, herring, eelpout), crab, jellyfish, shrimp, starfish
DATA: Brackish Dataset (own footage, 89 handpicked clips, Feb 20 - Mar 25 2019, single fixed camera)
V_EV: Sec. 4: 'The images also show the variation of turbidity between the videos, e.g., figure 5h shows high turbidity, while 5c has low turbidity.'
D_EV: Sec. 5.1: 'The dataset is split randomly into 80 % training, 10 % validation and 10 % test data.'
R_EV: Sec. 5: 'Two state-of-the-art CNN based object detectors (YOLOv2 and YOLOv3 [36, 37]) are tested on the new dataset in order to obtain baseline results' (single dataset only)
C_EV: Sec. 5.2 / Fig. 6: 'The AP is plotted against a prediction confidence threshold for the proposed dataset in Figure 6.' ... 'a low confidence threshold of 0.01 is chosen'
E_EV: Sec. 7: 'The fine-tuned YOLOv3 network achieved the best performance with AP ≈ 39% and AP50 ≈ 84%' (detection metrics only)
ARCH: YOLOv2 (VIAME, ImageNet + NOAA fish fine-tuned) and YOLOv3 (Open Images pre-trained), fine-tuned in Darknet, 416x416, 30k iterations
METR: AP@[0.5:0.95], AP50 (COCO/PASCAL style), per-class AP, AP vs confidence threshold
NOTE: Dataset paper with detector baselines. V: turbidity described qualitatively only (no NTU/Secchi); V2=Y for camera depth ('nine meters below the water surface'), V3=Y for illumination (LED lamps, 1900 lumens, one light always on) — coder interpreted V2/V3/V4 as depth/illumination/camera-subject range since the instructions do not define them individually; no stratified performance by turbidity. D: frame-level random 80/10/10 split from 89 clips; D3=N because the authors note 'multiple annotations of starfish which are near identical' without any de-duplication; D4=Y because this near-duplicate effect is explicitly invoked to explain inflated starfish AP (verifier may judge this as a weaker leakage discussion -> would make D_ALL=N). PRE: YOLOv2 ImageNet + NOAA underwater fine-tune, YOLOv3 Open Images (not an allowed value); coded ImageNet. FPS=Y refers to camera spec 'framerate up to 30 fps'. Dataset public on Kaggle; no code release stated.
